label: French Cuff — 6 Buttonholes
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Real photo, close crop: pale blue micro-check double (French) cuff folded back, block monogram embroidered on the outer leaf, one ornate gold cufflink through a single link point; grey jacket sleeve with 4 sleeve buttons at right. Unmistakably a squared French/double cuff, but only ONE link position exists and no extra perforations are countable, so the defining '6 buttonholes' configuration is not shown.

Real photo on dark wood: cream/ecru textured (royal-oxford-style weave) French cuff folded back, 'D A S' monogram in black thread on the leaf, single dark silk-knot cufflink through one link point. Squared double cuff confirmed; one closure point only, buttonholes not countable, so 6 buttonholes is unverified.

Real photo: man in a charcoal suit adjusting a white French cuff with both hands; rectangular silver cufflink set through one link point; jacket sleeve shows 4 buttons. Hands cover part of the cuff edge and only one link position is visible — no extra buttonholes countable.

Real photo, profile view: pale blue textured shirt sleeve with a folded double cuff at the wrist, one small metal link at a single closure point, navy trousers behind. Shot from too far and too oblique to count buttonholes; the 6-buttonhole configuration is not demonstrated.

Real photo: white French cuff on a wrist, round blue enamel cufflink through one link point, steel chronograph worn over the cuff, blue jacket and white pocket square in frame. Squared double cuff visible; only one closure point, so 6 buttonholes is not shown.
